checklists.name: SQL Database Engineering Standards
checklists.description: Validation checklist for ANSI SQL standards, schema migrations, query performance tuning, and SQL injection safety.

items.statement: All DDL and DML operations execute via parameter markers or prepared statements to prevent SQL injection.
Database schema migrations are version-controlled, idempotent, and reversible with explicit rollback logic.
Foreign keys, unique constraints, and check constraints enforce relational data integrity at the database layer.
Indexes are created for high-cardinality join and filter columns, and execution plans (EXPLAIN ANALYZE) confirm index usage.
Connection pools are configured with appropriate max connection limits, idle timeouts, and health checks.

obligationDefinitions.title: Query performance regressions must be tracked against their established baseline
obligationDefinitions.description: A query's execution plan can regress silently as data volume grows or statistics go stale; query performance must be tracked against its own established baseline on a recurring cadence, not noticed only when users complain.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: Key queries are compared against their performance baseline within the declared cadence, with regressions investigated.

requiredEvidence.title: Query performance regression report
requiredEvidence.description: Query execution time/plan comparison against the established baseline.
